About me

Hi, I’m Sid.

An entrepreneur, web developer and business content creator from Huvinahadagali, Karnataka, India. I build websites, run a few small ventures and help beginners understand business.

Professional background

I hold a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science (BE CSE). That training gave me a solid base in how software works, and I’ve applied it to practical, real-world work rather than only theory.

Today I work across technology and small business. I build websites for people and businesses, and I also run ventures in water purification and equipment, handmade gifting, and business education, alongside an advisory role in life insurance.

Web development

My technical interests centre on WordPress development, React and frontend development, business websites and landing pages, and the digital marketing side of online businesses. I like sites that load fast, read clearly on a phone and make it easy for a visitor to take the next step.

This is the work I offer through Sid’s PixelVows.

Entrepreneurial activities

I enjoy building small businesses from the ground up: understanding the customer, keeping costs realistic and being honest about what works. Each venture below serves a different audience with its own services.

Approach

Solving practical problems

  1. Listen first. I start with what you actually need, not what is easiest to sell.
  2. Keep it simple. The simplest solution that does the job well usually wins.
  3. Be upfront. Clear scope, honest timelines, and a straight answer when something isn’t a fit.
  4. Follow through. Ship, test, and improve based on how it really performs.

Values

What guides the work

  • TransparencyNo inflated claims or hidden steps.
  • Practical executionFocus on results that work in the real world.
  • Continuous learningAlways improving skills and methods.
  • Customer focusDecisions made around the people served.

Let’s talk about what you’re building

Whether it’s a website, equipment, a business idea or a gift, send an enquiry and I’ll get back to you.
